title: aether_converter probe output line
description: ONE line of `aether_converter probe --list <file>` (or `--stdin`) stdout: a JSON object per listed file, in list order (JSON Lines). Raw GeoTIFF header facts read from the IFDs with a few positioned reads (plus the last block's offset/byte count) — no pixels, no reprojection, no footprint. Every fact on an ok:true line equals what GDAL reports for the file (tools/probe_vs_gdal.py), except tile_h of a single uncompressed strip (the file's RowsPerStrip; GDAL shows libtiff's ~8 KB virtual strips) and scale/offset null where GDAL says 1/0 for a vertical CRS. A file the reader cannot vouch for is ok:false with a reason; the caller falls back to GDAL for it. Authoritative source: crates/aether_converter/src/probe.rs; contract: docs/CONTRACT.md §1.2 'probe'. Additive since aether_converter 0.2.7.

path.description: The list line exactly as given (not normalized).

ok.description: true: every header field below is present and GDAL-equal. false: only schema/path/ok/reason/size/mtime/mtime_ns.

reason.description: Present only when ok is false. Human-readable; starts with one of: 'cannot open', 'cannot stat', 'not a regular file', 'not a TIFF file', 'corrupt TIFF', 'corrupt BigTIFF header', 'truncated TIFF', 'read error', 'multi-band', 'palette', 'sub-byte samples', 'complex samples', 'unsupported sample type', 'photometric interpretation', 'no geotransform', 'GCP georeferencing', 'non-finite geotransform', 'user-defined CRS', 'GDAL_NODATA', 'GDAL_METADATA'.

size.description: File size in bytes (os.stat st_size); null when the file cannot be stat'ed.

mtime.description: Modification time in whole seconds, exactly Python's int(os.stat(p).st_mtime) (the plugin's size:mtime fingerprint).

mtime_ns.description: Modification time in nanoseconds, exactly Python's os.stat(p).st_mtime_ns (the plugin's terrain-index fingerprint).

bands.description: Samples per pixel; anything else is ok:false 'multi-band'.

dtype.description: GDAL data type (i8 = GDAL Byte with PIXELTYPE=SIGNEDBYTE before GDAL 3.7).

name.description: GDAL's COMPRESSION name (NONE, LZW, DEFLATE, PACKBITS, JPEG, ZSTD, WEBP, LERC, LZMA, JXL, CCITT*, …; UNKNOWN otherwise). LERC whatever its inner codec (GDAL: LERC_DEFLATE/LERC_ZSTD). Says nothing about whether ingest decodes it.

tile_w.description: TileWidth, or the image width for a stripped file.

tile_h.description: TileLength, or RowsPerStrip (clamped to the height) for a stripped file.

epsg.description: Horizontal EPSG code from the GeoKeys: ProjectedCSTypeGeoKey, else GeographicTypeGeoKey (a vertical code is ignored). null: the file carries no CRS at all (no GeoKeyDirectory, or one naming no coordinate system). Keys describing a CRS without an EPSG code are ok:false 'user-defined CRS'.

proj.description: Reserved for a CRS the GeoKeys define without an EPSG code. Always null in aether-probe/1 (such files are ok:false); consumers must accept a string here.

geotransform.description: GDAL order [x0, dx, rx, y0, ry, dy], from ModelPixelScale + the first ModelTiepoint (preferred, as GDAL), else ModelTransformation; a RasterPixelIsPoint origin already shifted to the pixel corner as GDAL does.

rotated.description: geotransform[2] != 0 or geotransform[4] != 0 (ingest refuses such sources).

nodata.description: GDAL_NODATA (42113) as GDAL parses it; null when absent; the strings for values JSON numbers cannot carry.

scale.description: Band-1 SCALE item of GDAL_METADATA (42112); null when absent (= 1).

offset.description: Band-1 OFFSET item of GDAL_METADATA (42112); null when absent (= 0).

overviews.description: Internal overviews: later IFDs with NewSubfileType bit 0 (reduced resolution) and not bit 2 (mask), with the image's sample count — GDAL's GetOverviewCount() without external .ovr files.

ifd_offset.description: Byte offset of the first IFD (GDAL band metadata IFD_OFFSET, domain TIFF).

last_chunk_end.description: Additive (CONTRACT changelog 35). Where the pixel data ends: offset + byte count of the image's LAST strip/tile (block count - 1 of the first IFD's TileOffsets/TileByteCounts, else StripOffsets/StripByteCounts) — the bottom-right block GDAL's truncation test reads; 0 when that block is sparse (byte count 0, read by GDAL as empty). Greater than size: the file is cut off behind an intact header (GDAL cannot read that block). null: those arrays cannot be read (absent, shorter than the block count, not unsigned integers, or past the end of the file) — GDAL cannot read the block either. Absent only from converters built before changelog 35: a consumer must then not take the pixel data as complete.
